disruptions.title: SEAJETS - Trip schedule modification for Milos - Sifnos
disruptions.content: 22 October 2026: Seajets' Milos - Sifnos trip will depart at 15:15 instead of 12:45 and arrive at 15:55 instead of 13:25.

disruptions.title: SEAJETS - Trip cancellations for ferry SPORADES STAR
disruptions.content:
On 22 October, the following trips operated by Seajets with ferry SPORADES STAR have been cancelled:

  • Mantoudi - Skiathos - Skopelos

  • Skopelos - Alonissos to Mantoudi

disruptions.title: SEAJETS - Trip cancellations and suspensions for ferry SUPERRUNNER JET
disruptions.content:
SEAJETS has cancelled or suspended the following SUPERRUNNER JET trips from 12 October to 28 October:

  • Paros - Rafina: cancelled.

  • Rafina - Paros - Naxos: suspended.
